id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9a9c: "I'm glad this church survived. It's everyone's emotional support. People would've been sad if it were gone.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9b8c: "Until reconstruction is done, the children will sleep at the church. The priest's thoughtful idea.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9c84: "God is always watching people. We should always live in a way we wouldn't be ashamed of before him.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9dcc: "Welcome to Cobblestone! This village is the birthplace of {var:1}, the Luminary and savior of Erdrea!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9e7c: "...What am I doing? Practicing welcoming tourists.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9f04: "I plan to promote Cobblestone big as the village where the Luminary was born and raised. I'm sure we'll rake it in!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a93c: "{var:1}, you're alive! You coming home feels like a dream...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a9c8: "The day the great tree fell I lost my husband, and our house and fields had burned when I crawled home...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|abfc: "The day the great tree fell I lost my husband, and our house and fields had burned when I crawled home...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ae30: "The day the great tree fell I lost my husband, and our house and fields had burned when I crawled home...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|aaec: "...My only hope is my son Cole. He wanted so badly to see you, so if you see him, say hello.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ad20: "...My only hope is my son Cole. He wanted so badly to see you, so if you see him, say hello.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|af54: "...My only hope is my son Cole. He wanted so badly to see you, so if you see him, say hello.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b050: "Cole was so excited, he went to welcome the hero. He seems happy that he's coming back.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b154: "{var:1}, please. If the worst happens, take just the children and flee the bastion.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b200: "If you're with them, the children will surely be saved...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b294: "Even if we withstand the monsters' attack, the sun won't return... This joy of victory is fleeting.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b3fc: "Everyone at the bastion is waiting, trusting you. Bring back the sun and return safely with Lord Hendrik.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b4fc: "Oh, the sun was so beautiful, I'd completely forgotten. It's sad, but we have to move forward.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b670: "This rubble... how awful. Thinking of cleanup and what's ahead wears me out.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b704: "But everyone came home safe and there's much to do, so we can't stay down forever!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b7d0: "{var:1}, don't you miss the taste of home on your journey? They say you never forget your mother's cooking.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b944: "I hear {var:1} worked with General Hendrik to defeat the monsters' boss.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b9d8: "Since he was held at Heliodor Castle, I thought he wasn't a bad man. I was right.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c2ac: "Everyone wants our horses to clear rubble, so they're booked solid. Ha ha!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c390: "These horses worked hard today too. The roof is gone, but I want them to at least eat properly.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c47c: "Cobblestone's reconstruction is done, so the horses can finally rest. You worked hard, all of you.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c55c: "Cobblestone's reconstruction is done, so the horses can finally rest. You worked hard, all of you.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c648: "Another walk with my beloved horses today. Same old days, but these ordinary days are the happiest.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c798: "Another walk with my beloved horses today. Same old days, but these ordinary days are the happiest.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c884: "You cherish your ordinary days with Gemma too. They'll become your treasure someday.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d1c8: "This is Cobblestone... oh, it's {var:1}. Look at the state of this village!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d250: "We'll rebuild it so we can say 'this is Cobblestone' again.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d340: "Look at Cobblestone, risen again! It's all thanks to you finding people on your travels and gathering them here. Thanks!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d444: "When I came back and saw the burned village, I thought it was hopeless, but things work out somehow.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d544: "Hey, congratulations on the wedding! It was an enviably perfect wedding! Now hurry and go see your bride!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d67c: "Oh, {var:1}, good timing. The cute young ladies over there are waiting for you.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d714: "They came all the way from far away to Cobblestone to see you. Go meet them soon.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d80c: "To think you have two such cute acquaintances, {var:1}, you rascal...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f978: "It really is you, {var:1}! I always believed you'd come back! Welcome home!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fa18: "The explosion was really scary, but remembering how you saved me gave me courage!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fadc: "So I could help the injured! I think I got one step closer to you! Hee hee!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fbec: "Grandma, I promise! Monsters are scary, but no matter what, I won't cry!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fc8c: "Because when I grow up I'll be a cool hero like {var:1}!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fd50: "The soldiers are all so cool! They say they took down the monsters that attacked this bastion left and right!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fe00: "You fought too, {var:1}, right? Wow! So cool!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fedc: "This kid has no dad or mom and is all alone. I figured that must be lonely.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ff88: "I promised this kid. No matter what, I'll protect them and stay with them forever.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1003: "Heh heh, it's embarrassing, so don't tell anyone. It's a secret between me and {var:1}.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|100e: "Heh heh, what I just said is embarrassing, so don't tell anyone. It's a secret between me and {var:1}.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|101c: "{var:1}, amazing! The one behind you is a hero, right?
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1021: "Taking a walk with a hero, as expected of {var:1}! So cool!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1036: "I didn't get what a hero was, but I think it's someone kind and strong like {var:1}!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1040: "When I grow up, I want to be a hero who protects everyone like {var:1}!!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|104d: "Look, {var:1}. Our house is a wreck! The soldiers did awful things.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1056: "Every house is like this. At Amber's, Gemma's helping out because the chief asked her.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1065: "The priest tells me to sleep early, but when I get in bed at night I'm too anxious to sleep.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1077: "{var:1}, are you leaving again? Don't worry Gemma too much. Make sure you come home. Promise!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1084: "You're married, yet you keep going out of the village. Stay by Gemma's side.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|109c: "Two women in strange clothes were waiting for you at the village entrance. They were really pretty.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10af: "Hey, {var:1}, you talked with those women so friendly. Are they friends? Or... could they be...?
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10be: "Huh? Hmm, suspicious... Well, fine, but if you make Gemma sad, I won't forgive you.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1137: "To reassure everyone in the village, I'm keeping watch like this. Times like this call for cooperation.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1146: "Phew, I'm sore all over from the rebuilding. I'm not young anymore. I can't be reckless like before.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1158: "{var:1}, a guest to see you is waiting at the north entrance.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1162: "I heard that and kept watch so you wouldn't leave the village. Hurry to your guest.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11dc: "Goodness... I never dreamed I'd be doing heavy labor at my age.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11e8: "But there aren't enough hands, so it can't be helped. Let me show the village I'm still young.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11f9: "Look at Cobblestone now. Thanks to everyone's hard work, it's back to the form you know.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1206: "However hard it is, if you try hard, there's nothing you can't overcome. Don't you lose heart either.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1217: "{var:1}, you've been through many hardships on your adventure. I can tell by your face.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1222: "But you never gave up against any difficulty. You're a fine adult now.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|122a: "From now on, hold your head high and live your own life.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1282: "Everyone was worried about you. Amber especially looks normal now, but at first her face was pale with worry.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1291: "Don't mind the broken village. As long as you're safe, that's all anyone wants. Got it?
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|129e: "I came to ask the chief whether I could use his horses tomorrow. I want to speed up the cleanup.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12b0: "Welcome back! Have you seen Gemma yet? When the village was rebuilt, she was happier than anyone...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12bc: "She's been waiting for you to come back to thank you properly.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12ce: "When you came home safe, Amber cried for joy. She worried about you that much.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12d9: "You've worried her all this time, so now you must be a good son.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12e7: "When you came home safe, Gemma cried for joy. She worried about you that much.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12f2: "You've worried her all this time, so now you must cherish your wife.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1303: "How to be a good son? Easy. Just spend as much time as you can with Amber.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|130f: "Being with a beloved child is a parent's greatest happiness.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|131e: "How to make Gemma happy? Easy. Tell her you love her often.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1328: "A girl likes her beloved's words more than any present.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|139d: "While we couldn't see you, Gemma's gloom was unbearable to watch.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13a7: "But now her smile is back. You've got your troubles, but come back often and show your face.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13b7: "Seeing you in the village is oddly reassuring. It feels like everyday life is there.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13d8: "Seeing you in the village is oddly reassuring. It feels like everyday life is there.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13c8: "Don't you ever die. I won't forgive anything that makes Gemma sad!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13e9: "Don't you ever die. I won't forgive anything that makes Gemma sad!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13fa: "The monsters' boss was a huge monster sealed in the Luminary's star, right?
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1404: "It's way too big for me to follow, but defeating such a thing, you're amazing.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1465: "Wow! {var:1}, you're back! Amazing! I'm so happy to see you again!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|146d: "When I was at Heliodor Castle there was a huge explosion, but I don't remember much of it.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1496: "When I was at Heliodor Castle there was a huge explosion, but I don't remember much of it.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14bf: "When I was at Heliodor Castle there was a huge explosion, but I don't remember much of it.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1477: "It was so scary, and Daddy told me to hide in the horse house... and I haven't seen Daddy since.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14a0: "It was so scary, and Daddy told me to hide in the horse house... and I haven't seen Daddy since.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14c9: "It was so scary, and Daddy told me to hide in the horse house... and I haven't seen Daddy since.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1483: "But if I'm a good girl, Daddy will surely come back. So I'll do my best caring for the horses.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14ac: "But if I'm a good girl, Daddy will surely come back. So I'll do my best caring for the horses.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14d5: "But if I'm a good girl, Daddy will surely come back. So I'll do my best caring for the horses.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14e6: "The horses are big and noticeable, so we couldn't bring them here...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14f5: "The horses were all safe! They're all so strong and good! I'm really happy!

tm.「この教会が残ってて よかったよ。\n ここは みんなの心の よりどころだからな: "I'm glad this church survived. It's everyone's emotional support. People would've been sad if it were gone.
tm.「復興が終わるまで 子供たちは\n 教会に 寝泊まりさせることに なったんだ。\: "Until reconstruction is done, the children will sleep at the church. The priest's thoughtful idea.
tm.「いつだって 神さまは 人間を見てるんだ。\n 神さまに見られても 恥ずかしくな: "God is always watching people. We should always live in a way we wouldn't be ashamed of before him.
tm.「イシの村へ ようこそ！\n この村は ロトゼタシアの救世主\n 勇者 {var: "Welcome to Cobblestone! This village is the birthplace of {var:1}, the Luminary and savior of Erdrea!
tm.「……え なにしてるのかって？\n 旅行客を歓迎する 練習をしてるのさ。: "...What am I doing? Practicing welcoming tourists.
tm.「イシの村を 勇者が生まれ育った村として\n 大々的に 売り出そうと思ってね。\: "I plan to promote Cobblestone big as the village where the Luminary was born and raised. I'm sure we'll rake it in!
tm.「{var:1} 生きていたのね！\n アナタが 帰ってくるなんて\n まるで: "{var:1}, you're alive! You coming home feels like a dream...
tm.「大樹が 地に落ちた日に 夫を失い\n 真っ暗闇の中を 命からがら 村に帰ってみ: "The day the great tree fell I lost my husband, and our house and fields had burned when I crawled home...
tm.「……私の希望は もう 息子のマノロだけ。\n アナタに とっても会いたがってい: "...My only hope is my son Cole. He wanted so badly to see you, so if you see him, say hello.
tm.「マノロったら とっても はしゃいで\n 英雄殿の お出むかえに行ったわ。\n: "Cole was so excited, he went to welcome the hero. He seems happy that he's coming back.
tm.「{var:1}。お願いよ。\n もしもの時には 子供たちだけでも連れて\n 砦: "{var:1}, please. If the worst happens, take just the children and flee the bastion.
tm.「アナタが 一緒なら\n きっと 子供たちは助かるわ……。: "If you're with them, the children will surely be saved...
tm.「魔物の攻撃に たえたとしても\n 太陽が 戻ってくるわけじゃないわ……。\n: "Even if we withstand the monsters' attack, the sun won't return... This joy of victory is fleeting.
tm.「砦のみんなは アナタを信じて待っているわ。\n きっと 太陽を取り戻して\n: "Everyone at the bastion is waiting, trusting you. Bring back the sun and return safely with Lord Hendrik.
tm.「ああ 太陽が こんなにも美しかったなんて\n すっかり忘れていたわ。\n 悲し: "Oh, the sun was so beautiful, I'd completely forgotten. It's sad, but we have to move forward.
tm.「このガレキ……ひどいものね まったく。\n 片付けとか これからのことを 考え: "This rubble... how awful. Thinking of cleanup and what's ahead wears me out.
tm.「でも みんな 無事に帰ってこられたし\n やらなきゃいけないことも 多いから\: "But everyone came home safe and there's much to do, so we can't stay down forever!
tm.「{var:1}も 旅の途中で\n 故郷の味が 恋しくなったりしない？\n 母親: "{var:1}, don't you miss the taste of home on your journey? They say you never forget your mother's cooking.
tm.「{var:1}は グレイグ将軍と協力して\n 魔物の親玉を 倒したんですってね: "I hear {var:1} worked with General Hendrik to defeat the monsters' boss.
tm.「デルカダール城に 捕らわれていたときから\n 彼は 悪い人じゃないと思ってたの: "Since he was held at Heliodor Castle, I thought he wasn't a bad man. I was right.
tm.「みんなが ガレキの片付けに使おうとして\n うちのウマが 引っぱりだこでな。\: "Everyone wants our horses to clear rubble, so they're booked solid. Ha ha!
tm.「こいつら 今日も はたらいてくれたからな。\n 屋根は すっかり無くなっちまっ: "These horses worked hard today too. The roof is gone, but I want them to at least eat properly.
tm.「イシの村の復興が 終わったから\n やっと ウマたちを ゆっくりさせてやれる。: "Cobblestone's reconstruction is done, so the horses can finally rest. You worked hard, all of you.
tm.「今日も 大好きなウマと一緒に 散歩さ。\n かわりばえしない 毎日だけど\n: "Another walk with my beloved horses today. Same old days, but these ordinary days are the happiest.
tm.「お前も エマちゃんとの何気ない日々を\n 大切にするんだよ。それが いつかきっ: "You cherish your ordinary days with Gemma too. They'll become your treasure someday.
tm.「ここは イシの村だよ……\n って なんだ {var:1}じゃないか。\n 見: "This is Cobblestone... oh, it's {var:1}. Look at the state of this village!
tm.「がんばって 村を立て直して\n また ここは イシの村だよって\n 言えるよう: "We'll rebuild it so we can say 'this is Cobblestone' again.
tm.「見てくれよ 立ち直った イシの村の姿を！\n 全部 お前が旅先で 人を探して\: "Look at Cobblestone, risen again! It's all thanks to you finding people on your travels and gathering them here. Thanks!
tm.「戻ってきて 焼け落ちた村を見たときは\n もうダメだーって 思ったもんだが\n: "When I came back and saw the burned village, I thought it was hopeless, but things work out somehow.
tm.「よう 結婚おめでとう！\n うらやましいくらいに 最高の結婚式だったぜ！\n: "Hey, congratulations on the wedding! It was an enviably perfect wedding! Now hurry and go see your bride!
tm.「おっ {var:1} いいところに来た。\n あそこにいる かわいいお嬢さんた: "Oh, {var:1}, good timing. The cute young ladies over there are waiting for you.
tm.「お前に会うために 遠くから\n はるばる イシの村まで 来たそうだ。\n 早く: "They came all the way from far away to Cobblestone to see you. Go meet them soon.
tm.「しかし あんなに かわいい知り合いが\n ふたりもいるなんて {var:1}も: "To think you have two such cute acquaintances, {var:1}, you rascal...
tm.「ホントに ホントに {var:1}なんだね！\n オイラ {var:1}は き: "It really is you, {var:1}! I always believed you'd come back! Welcome home!
tm.「あのバクハツの時 すごく こわかったけど\n {var:1}に 助けられた時の: "The explosion was really scary, but remembering how you saved me gave me courage!
tm.「だから ケガした人の手助けができたんだよ！\n これでオイラも {var:1}: "So I could help the injured! I think I got one step closer to you! Hee hee!
tm.「おばあちゃん。約束するよ！\n 魔物は おっかないけど\n オイラは 何が あ: "Grandma, I promise! Monsters are scary, but no matter what, I won't cry!
tm.「だって オイラは オトナになったら\n {var:1}みたいに\n かっちょい: "Because when I grow up I'll be a cool hero like {var:1}!
tm.「兵士さんたち みんな かっちょいいな～！\n この砦を おそった魔物を\n バ: "The soldiers are all so cool! They say they took down the monsters that attacked this bastion left and right!
tm.「{var:1}も 一緒に戦ったんでしょ？\n すごいなー！ かっちょいいなー！: "You fought too, {var:1}, right? Wow! So cool!
tm.「この子 父さんも母さんも いなくて\n ひとりぽっち なんだって。\n それっ: "This kid has no dad or mom and is all alone. I figured that must be lonely.
tm.「オイラ この子と約束したんだ。\n どんなときでも オイラが守ってあげる。\n: "I promised this kid. No matter what, I'll protect them and stay with them forever.
tm.「へへへ はずかしいから\n 誰にも言わないでね。\n オイラと {var:1}: "Heh heh, it's embarrassing, so don't tell anyone. It's a secret between me and {var:1}.
tm.「へへへ さっき言ったこと\n はずかしいから 誰にも言わないでね。\n オイラ: "Heh heh, what I just said is embarrassing, so don't tell anyone. It's a secret between me and {var:1}.
tm.「{var:1} すっごいね！\n 後ろにいるのって エイユウでしょ？: "{var:1}, amazing! The one behind you is a hero, right?
tm.「エイユウと 一緒に 散歩するなんて\n {var:1}は さすがだなー！\n: "Taking a walk with a hero, as expected of {var:1}! So cool!
tm.「ユウシャって よく わかんなかったけど\n {var:1}みたいに\n 優しく: "I didn't get what a hero was, but I think it's someone kind and strong like {var:1}!
